contract_snapshot.title: Handover service (the core flows)
contract_snapshot.interface: Exception HandoverError(ValueError). class HandoverService(handovers, assignments, assets, employees, audit, email, tokens, base_url, company, protocol_dir) — all keyword arguments, stored as public attributes of the same names. start_handover(actor, asset_id, employee_id, note='') -> dict: asset must exist with status 'in_stock' and employee must exist and be active, else HandoverError; creates handover kind 'handover' with protocol_number=handovers.next_protocol_number(current UTC year); sets asset status 'pending_handover'; sends e-mail to the employee (subject 'Potvrzení převzetí zařízení <asset_tag>', text and html containing asset_tag, brand, model, serial number, note, and the link '<base_url>/handovers/confirm/<token>' where token=tokens.issue(handover_id, employee email)); marks sent; audit 'handover.started'; returns the handover dict. start_return(actor, asset_id, note='') -> dict: requires an open assignment (assignments.get_open_for_asset) else HandoverError; creates handover kind 'return' for that assignment's employee; asset status 'pending_return'; e-mail (subject 'Potvrzení vrácení zařízení <asset_tag>') with the same kind of link; audit 'return.started'. request_return(employee_email, asset_id, note='') -> dict: like start_return but the actor is the employee, who must be the holder of the open assignment (else HandoverError); created_by=employee_email. confirm(token, actor_email) -> dict: tokens.verify(token) must succeed, the handover must be 'pending', and actor_email.lower() must equal the token email and the handover employee's email, else HandoverError. For kind 'handover': open an assignment, asset status 'assigned'. For kind 'return': close the open assignment with return_id, asset status 'in_stock'. Then render the PDF via render_protocol_pdf to '<protocol_dir>/<protocol_number>.pdf', set_status 'confirmed' with confirmed_at (UTC ISO) and protocol_path, e-mail the PDF (attachment (f'{protocol_number}.pdf', bytes, 'application/pdf')) to both the employee and created_by (two messages), audit 'handover.confirmed'; return the updated handover dict. decline(token, actor_email, reason='') -> dict: same token/actor checks; status 'declined' with decline_reason; asset back to 'in_stock' for kind 'handover' or 'assigned' for kind 'return'; audit 'handover.declined'. cancel(actor, handover_id) -> dict: only a 'pending' handover (else HandoverError); status 'cancelled'; asset back to 'in_stock' / 'assigned' as for decline; audit 'handover.cancelled'. overview_for_employee(employee_id) -> dict {'assigned': [{'assignment': dict, 'asset': dict, 'handover': dict}], 'pending': [{**handover dict, 'asset': asset dict}], 'history': [handover dicts newest first]}. expire_stale(older_than_hours) -> int: every 'pending' handover whose created_at is older than the given hours becomes 'expired' with the asset released as for decline; returns the count. Helper with_details(handover) -> dict adds 'asset' and 'employee' dicts. Never catch generic Exception; never send e-mail before the database write succeeded.
